note: challonei shequfim 'atumim is an architectural term of uncertain meaning, perhaps framed, latticed or closed (clerestory) windows.
devir is the innermost room (the Holy of Holies). "Oracle" follows the Vulgate's oraculum ("place of speaking") and now suggests a prophetess. It recurs through chs. 6-8.

kjv: the lintel and side posts were a fifth part of the wall
mine: the lintel and the doorposts formed a pentagon
note: ha'ayil mezuzot chamishit is obscure. It may describe a five-sided doorframe, or a frame that was a fifth of the wall's width. The KJV supplies "of the wall".
